sources.snippet: SmolVLM2-500M-Video SmolVLM2-500M-Video is a lightweight multimodal model designed to analyze video content. The model processes videos, images, and text inputs to generate text outputs - whether answering questions about media files, comparing visual content, or transcribing text from images.
